scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team adopts a non-blocking Lintwise trial in its monorepo, with agreed evaluation criteria, a review date, and a rollback path; results on actionable findings, false positives, language coverage, CI runtime, and queue impact will inform a later decision on requiring individual rules.

objectors.reason: We have not measured Lintwise’s effect on our 11-minute CI builds or queue length before making it a required pre-merge check.
The motion still requires the whole tool, rather than a non-blocking trial followed by review of individual rules and a rollback path.

chairQuestions.experience_sought: What bugs did Lintwise catch during your six months of use, and how comparable were that codebase and CI setup to ours?

chairQuestions.topic: Merge-policy constraints on a non-blocking trial
chairQuestions.experience_sought: What existing merge-policy requirements would affect running Lintwise as a non-blocking check in our monorepo?

reminders.quote: Lintwise’s documentation describes a baseline mode that ignores existing findings and reports only new ones; we should test that, while separately assessing existing findings.
Our pipeline code has no static checks today, and two outages last year came from typos in config keys.
